out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Paper towels were missing from one hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The final rinse temperature of the warewashing machine was not high enough. The machine was run five times with the following readings: 143º, 150º, 158º, 158º and 173º. The PIC stated the machine is not used, but it was turned on and functioning. Also, the concentration of the sanitizing solution at the three compartment sink was 0 ppm. This was due to the hose not being in the sanitizer bottle and no sanitizer bottle being present.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. The warewashing machine issue was corrected by repeatedly running it through its cycle. Check the warewashing machine daily to ensure it is working properly. Check the three compartment sink sanitizing solution concentration daily to ensure it is mixing properly. If both these are not checked routinely, you can’t be sure you are properly sanitizing all equipment and utensils as required. The PIC replaced the quaternary ammonia sanitizer bottle. The concentration was corrected to 150 ppm before the inspection concluded. CDI.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: there was fat/grease and food debris visible on the meat slicer. Several measuring cups in the measuring cups storage drawer were not clean.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The PIC cleaned the slicer and the measuring cups. CDI.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the handle for the ice scoop was in the ice in the ice machine bin.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Keep the handle out of the ice to avoid touching ice with hands. The EHS moved the handle out of the ice during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the drawer where the measuring cups are stored was visibly soiled.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. The PIC cleaned the drawer during the inspection to correct.CDI.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Water flow at the hand sink next to the soda dispenser was very slow and inadequate for proper hand washing.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Please submit a work order to have this problem assessed and corrected. FALLS CHURCH RESTAURANT TRADE ESTABLISHMENT (Inspection Date: 05/11/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. The person in charge could not provide a vomit and diarrhea clean-up procedure or kit.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. The EHS provided the person in charge with the Fairfax County model vomit and diarrhea clean-up policy which will be implemented. CDI.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed several (4) chemical spray bottles (Lysol disinfectant, RTU disinfectant and glass cleaner) stored on food preparation tables.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The person in charge moved all the chemicals to proper locations during the visit. CDI.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: a cambro container of flour and three large Piper brand ingredient containers (flour, sugar)were not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. The person in charge labeled all the containers during the visit. CDI.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed three bags of ice stored on the walk-in freezer floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. The person in charge moved the bags of ice to the freezer shelving during the visit. CDI.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Several students working in the food prep area were not wearing hair restraints while prepping food, as required.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. The person in charge has ordered uniforms with hats for students, which have not yet been delivered. Please provide other disposable hair restraints such as paper hats or hair nets or have students wear their own hats until the uniform hats are delivered and distributed. Students with long enough hair can tie it back and don’t have to wear a hair restraint.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sinks located in the center of the kitchen and by the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM provided paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: multiple containers of seasonings, sugar, yeast without common names.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM labeled the containers with the common names for compliance.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Inspect Premises
violations.observation: There were rodent droppings found throughout the storage area, in the corners, on the shelves and on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: The facility is undergoing construction which is causing an increase of pests in the building. The facility will need to be inspected for possible pests and the facility will need to be cleaned to remove droppings, clean and sanitize the premises. The CFM is putting in a work order.
